holder-quote: Her [Wild General], Vasraf.

She lay there, depression overtaking her. She still stayed in contact with them, despite being [Animalfriend Exile], no longer [Empress of Beasts]. Her trusted [Wild General], Vasraf, still led a resistance from the steppes, raiding the enemy armies holding Tiqr, freeing her subjects from slavery and bondage.

Vasraf was noticeable in how he and Nsiia played off each other. He was a [Wild General], but his deep voice, his short-cut beard, and the way his features always seemed so watchful, piercing blue eyes in brown skin, made him the opposite of Nsiia.
The [Wild General]’s eyebrows shot into his helmet. Ksmvr started.
Vasraf started. The [Wild General] looked up and smiled a second.
The [Wild General] refused. So Nsiia leapt forwards and all three of them were doing it.
One of the veteran soldiers observed. Vasraf nodded, but he was frowning. He turned to Nsiia.
Domehead walked towards Nsiia. He stopped, and the Empress of Beasts turned a rueful smile towards Vasraf.
The blunt suggestion came from one of Vasraf’s officers. Ksmvr hesitated. He looked at Crafter Se. He did not wish that, but he listened. The [Wild General] shook his head.

She pointed down at a [Soldier] angrily moving the people forwards. By hitting them as hard as he could with the butt of his spear. Ksmvr saw Vasraf stare down as he spat on a man. The [Wild General] sighed.
He’d seen it too. The [Wild General] furiously blew a horn and pointed to intercept, but even as both watched, the [Riders] sped up.
When the Empress of Beasts parted the crowds with her [Wild General], he was standing there, surrounded by Tiqr’s people.
Seelaw Ya landed as the [Wild General] ordered the camp struck.
The [Wild General] eyed thousands of Scaied’s mercenary army.
The [Wild General] nodded.
Vasraf was looking at Ksmvr, holding his tongue, but the [Wild General] kept glancing at his [Empress].
Vasraf had dropped the water flask he was holding, and the precious liquid dribbled into the sand, but the [Wild General] didn’t even notice.
The [Wild General] saw the [Empress of Beasts] turn her head. But her gaze never left Ksmvr.
Vasraf had aimed an arrow at him once; the Gold-rank adventurer cut it in half mid-flight. The [Wild General] didn’t bother after that.
The [Wild General] pointed. Nsiia turned and saw Ksmvr.
The [Wild General] crouched beside Ksmvr. The Antinium shook his head slightly.
The [Wild General] nodded. He stood and strode back to the front.
Vasraf looked at her as she swung herself onto the nearest mount. Spitty led her down in a mad charge. The [Wild General] turned.
You know my [Wild General], Vasraf.
Vasraf was assuring Shurein, who was very humble, clearly impressed by the shorter man.
A [Wild General] Narrina. Gnoll.
